rows.description: I watch full-time staff coast while I cover their work for free, and I seethe. Wise: name the unfairness, negotiate scope, and use the experience without letting it sour my view of all work. Harmful: sabotage or quiet spite.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: exploitation, indebtedness, loyalty, pride, respect

rows.description: We interns cover for each other and share tips on staying afloat. Wise: solidarity is powerful; together we can raise concerns about hours and pay. Harmful: competing for scraps and informing on each other.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: exploitation, indebtedness, pride, resentment, respect

rows.description: My parent proudly tells relatives I work at a big firm, while I feel like a free helper. I feel a guilty gap. Wise: tell the truth gently and explain what I am learning and what I plan next. Harmful: keeping the pretence up.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: exploitation, indebtedness, loyalty, resentment, respect

rows.description: The app cuts my per-trip rate and blocks my ID with no human to speak to. I feel powerless against an algorithm. Wise: keep screenshots, join a workers' group, track real earnings after fuel, and build other income.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, dependence, loyalty, shame

rows.description: A customer scolds me at the door for being three minutes late, with no eye contact. I feel invisible. Wise: stay calm, keep my dignity, use the app's report tools, and remember his rudeness is about him.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, dependence, exploitation, loyalty, shame

rows.description: A customer offers water and says "take care on the road". A tiny kindness makes my day. Wise: accept it warmly and pass it on. Harmful: none; but do not let strangers' moods decide my self-worth either way.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: contempt, dependence, exploitation, loyalty, shame

rows.description: I stay online eleven hours chasing incentive targets, tired and hoping the next bonus fixes things. Wise: calculate hourly earnings honestly and rest; incentives are designed to keep me hooked. Harmful: driving exhausted.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, exploitation, loyalty, shame

rows.description: Riders at the tea stall share safe routes, warn about bad customers and help with a broken bike. I feel belonging. Wise: nurture this network and use it to ask for better terms together.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, dependence, exploitation, shame

rows.description: I hide from relatives that I deliver food because they see it as low status. I feel a private sting. Wise: honest work is nothing to be ashamed of; explain my plan and timeline. Harmful: lying and drifting into stagnation.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, contempt, dependence, exploitation, loyalty

rows.description: I fear that asking for more will make them withdraw the offer. Wise: research the range, state a reasoned number politely, and be ready to accept the answer. Harmful: silently accepting far less out of dread.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: guilt, manipulation, pride, rivalry, trust
